newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures surge at close after firm SQ.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures surge at close after firm SQ.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures surged more than 300 points on Friday following a positive Special Quotation (SQ) for the settlement of September futures and options.
After hitting a high of 20,945, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract closed at 20,880 against a previous settlement at 20,565. But volume on SIMEX was relatively low at 15,090 lots.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei-225 average closed up 398.71 points at 20,842.64.
"After the SQ-related buying on the cash market, foreign houses pushed the futures higher," said a trader with a Japanese institution.

He said the December Nikkei's next resistance was at 21,050/80, with a break above that level seen pushing it to 21,500. "The downtrend could possibly be changing but the technical picture could be distorted by today's big upmove." -- Sonali Desai (65-8703090)
